hack.root_cause: Controllable transferFrom() in unverified (closed-source) swap contract — approval drain
hack.description: Transit Swap's closed-source contract had a fully controllable transferFrom() that let an attacker drain $21M from any wallet with active approvals — 70% was returned only after security teams uncovered the hacker's identity.
